_about: Indicator definitions. Each 'expr' is evaluated per micro-watershed (MWS) with the safe expression language in seft/expr.py. Dataset aliases: lulc=lulc_vector, ci=croppingintensity_annual, drought=croppingdrought_kharif, hydro=hydrological_annual, swb=surfacewaterbodies_annual, aquifer=aquifer_vector, terrain, soge=soge_vector, rest=restoration_vector, degr=change_detection_degradation, tcd=change_detection_deforestation (formerly change_detection_tree_cover_decrease), tci=change_detection_afforestation (formerly _increase), urb=change_detection_urbanization, canal (n, projects), gc=green_credit (n), mine=mining (n: mining sites or projects), vill=village census and livestock apportioned to the MWS by area of intersection, soil=soil_health, nrega=nrega_annual (yearly work counts by category; series named by category, e.g. nrega.community_assets), anty=antyodaya (Mission Antyodaya village survey, household counts apportioned by area), fac=facilities_proximity (village distances, area-weighted mean), river=river (n rows), conn=mws_connectivity (n_upstream), fringe=forest_fringes, fire=forest_fire, tig=tree_in_grassland, ndvi=ndvi. Rows in the documented schema (unit- and year-suffixed columns, CS-74) are mapped to these names by seft/schema.py. Column names of the newer datasets are lower-cased with spaces and hyphens replaced by '_'; yearly columns ending in _YYYY or _YYYY-YYYY become series. 'area' is MWS area in ha. Annual columns are series over agricultural years 2017-2024. Variables may use earlier variables by id. 'series': true marks helper series that are not exported. 'min_coverage' names a coverage variable that must be >= 0.2 (MIN_COVERAGE in seft/indicators.py) or the value is set to missing. Coverage is below 1 mainly where an MWS extends beyond the district: only villages inside the selected district are listed by the API. Density-type variables divide by the area of the covered villages, so partial coverage does not bias them.

groups.landcover: Land use and land cover (mean of annual shares of MWS area)
groups.water: Water balance, groundwater and surface water
groups.context: Static context: aquifer, terrain, groundwater assessment
groups.society: Village population and livestock (apportioned by area)

variables.label: Cropland share of MWS
variables.description: Mean annual net cropped area (single+double+triple) / MWS area.

variables.label: Built-up share (mean)
variables.note: The loader renames built-up_area to built_up_area.

variables.label: Open commons share (shrub+barren)
variables.description: Proxy for grazing commons and wastelands.

variables.label: Kharif-only water share
variables.description: Water seen only in the monsoon season: seasonal ponding, flood spread or tanks that dry by rabi.

variables.label: Non-kharif cropped share of cropland
variables.description: Share of net cropped area that carries a crop outside kharif (double, triple or rabi-only). In the dry season this requires irrigation or residual moisture, so it is the main irrigation proxy.

variables.label: Rabi water-body area over kharif water-body area (mean of years)
variables.description: Below 1 means surface water shrinks between kharif and rabi.

variables.label: Rabi-only share of cropland
variables.description: Single crop grown only after the monsoon: residual-moisture (black soils) or irrigated rabi.

variables.label: Cropping intensity trend
variables.description: Theil-Sen slope, 2017-2024.

variables.label: Cropping intensity, last 2 years minus first 2
Trend in double-cropped area
variables.description: Change in double+triple cropped share of the MWS, percentage points per year.

variables.label: Kharif area sown (mean, % of reference)
variables.description: Mean kharif cropped area as a percentage of the reference kharif area (drought dataset), so values below 100 mean part of the kharif cropland went unsown.

variables.label: Driest year's rainfall (rescaled to district normal)
variables.description: Lowest annual rainfall over the record, rescaled like rain_norm.

variables.label: Share of annual rainfall falling in kharif
variables.description: Mean kharif rainfall over mean annual rainfall. On CoRE's seasons a sizeable part of the monsoon falls in 'zaid', so this measures how much rain falls outside the main kharif window (including north-east monsoon rainfall).

variables.label: ET / precipitation
variables.description: Above ~0.9 the landscape consumes almost all rainfall; above 1 it draws on storage or imported (canal) water.

variables.label: Cumulative water-level change 2017-24
variables.description: Sum of the annual 'welldepth' column (storage change divided by specific yield). Positive = rise.

variables.label: Tree-cover gain over tree-cover loss
variables.description: Below 1 means more tree cover was lost than gained, relative to the loss itself rather than to the MWS area.

variables.label: Forest converted to farm, as a share of the forest area
Tree cover lost relative to tree cover
Share of MWS covered by villages with census data
Share of MWS covered by villages with livestock data
Tropical livestock units
variables.description: FAO tropical livestock unit coefficients for South Asia (cattle 0.5, buffalo 0.5, sheep 0.1, goat 0.1, pig 0.2).

variables.label: Livestock per ha of open commons
Sheep and goat share of livestock
Green Credit projects
variables.description: An empty green_credit section means no Green Credit project in the MWS.

variables.label: Mining sites or projects in the MWS
variables.description: Rows of the CoRE Stack mining layer in this MWS: environmental-clearance mining proposals (MoEFCC) and mapped mining sites whose proposal is listed as 'unknown'. Missing when the dataset was not fetched.

variables.label: Rainfall rescaled to district normal
variables.description: rain_factor = district normal / district median of precip_mean (contexts.json rainfall_normals); 1 when no normal is given. Set by the pipeline.

variables.label: Sloping land share (hill slope + ridge + gentle slope)
Water spread surviving into summer (0 where no water body)
variables.description: Like swb_zaid_persist, but an MWS with no water body scores 0 (no surface water in summer) instead of missing.

variables.label: Share of cropped area with low available nitrogen (< 280 kg/ha)
variables.expr: frac_below_nz(280, [soil.n_p05_in_kg_per_ha, soil.n_p10_in_kg_per_ha, soil.n_p20_in_kg_per_ha, soil.n_p30_in_kg_per_ha, soil.n_p40_in_kg_per_ha, soil.n_p50_in_kg_per_ha, soil.n_p60_in_kg_per_ha, soil.n_p70_in_kg_per_ha, soil.n_p80_in_kg_per_ha, soil.n_p90_in_kg_per_ha, soil.n_p95_in_kg_per_ha])
variables.description: Interpolated from the soil_health percentiles, which describe the cropped area of the MWS (e.g. n_p30 is the value below which 30% of the cropped area lies). 280 kg/ha is the Soil Health Card 'low' class limit. Nitrogen values of exactly 0 are read as missing (CS-91): the share is taken over the cropped area that has data, and the value is missing if 90% or more is zero.

variables.expr: frac_below(10, [soil.p_p05_in_kg_per_ha, soil.p_p10_in_kg_per_ha, soil.p_p20_in_kg_per_ha, soil.p_p30_in_kg_per_ha, soil.p_p40_in_kg_per_ha, soil.p_p50_in_kg_per_ha, soil.p_p60_in_kg_per_ha, soil.p_p70_in_kg_per_ha, soil.p_p80_in_kg_per_ha, soil.p_p90_in_kg_per_ha, soil.p_p95_in_kg_per_ha])
variables.description: Interpolated from the soil_health percentiles, which describe the cropped area of the MWS (e.g. p_p30 is the value below which 30% of the cropped area lies). 10 kg/ha is the Soil Health Card 'low' class limit.

variables.expr: frac_below(0.5, [soil.oc_p05_in_percent, soil.oc_p10_in_percent, soil.oc_p20_in_percent, soil.oc_p30_in_percent, soil.oc_p40_in_percent, soil.oc_p50_in_percent, soil.oc_p60_in_percent, soil.oc_p70_in_percent, soil.oc_p80_in_percent, soil.oc_p90_in_percent, soil.oc_p95_in_percent])

variables.label: Share of cropped area with phosphorus below the high class (< 25 kg/ha)
variables.expr: frac_below(25, [soil.p_p05_in_kg_per_ha, soil.p_p10_in_kg_per_ha, soil.p_p20_in_kg_per_ha, soil.p_p30_in_kg_per_ha, soil.p_p40_in_kg_per_ha, soil.p_p50_in_kg_per_ha, soil.p_p60_in_kg_per_ha, soil.p_p70_in_kg_per_ha, soil.p_p80_in_kg_per_ha, soil.p_p90_in_kg_per_ha, soil.p_p95_in_kg_per_ha])
variables.description: 25 kg/ha is the Soil Health Card medium/high boundary for available P, so this counts low and medium values.

variables.label: Share of cropped area with potassium below the high class (< 280 kg/ha)
variables.expr: frac_below(280, [soil.k_p05_in_kg_per_ha, soil.k_p10_in_kg_per_ha, soil.k_p20_in_kg_per_ha, soil.k_p30_in_kg_per_ha, soil.k_p40_in_kg_per_ha, soil.k_p50_in_kg_per_ha, soil.k_p60_in_kg_per_ha, soil.k_p70_in_kg_per_ha, soil.k_p80_in_kg_per_ha, soil.k_p90_in_kg_per_ha, soil.k_p95_in_kg_per_ha])
variables.description: 280 kg/ha is the Soil Health Card medium/high boundary for available K, so this counts low and medium values.

variables.label: Share of cropped area with very low nitrogen (< 140 kg/ha)
variables.expr: frac_below_nz(140, [soil.n_p05_in_kg_per_ha, soil.n_p10_in_kg_per_ha, soil.n_p20_in_kg_per_ha, soil.n_p30_in_kg_per_ha, soil.n_p40_in_kg_per_ha, soil.n_p50_in_kg_per_ha, soil.n_p60_in_kg_per_ha, soil.n_p70_in_kg_per_ha, soil.n_p80_in_kg_per_ha, soil.n_p90_in_kg_per_ha, soil.n_p95_in_kg_per_ha])
variables.description: Half the Soil Health Card low limit (280 kg/ha). Below-280 holds over most cropland in 78% of MWS, so only very low N is counted as a deficiency. Zeros are read as missing (CS-91).

variables.label: Median available nitrogen over cropped area
variables.description: Missing where the median is 0, which marks missing nitrogen data (CS-91).

variables.label: Median organic carbon over cropped area
NREGA works 2017–24 (all categories)
variables.expr: sum(nz(nrega.community_assets)) + sum(nz(nrega.irrigation_on_farms)) + sum(nz(nrega.land_restoration)) + sum(nz(nrega.off_farm_livelihood_assets)) + sum(nz(nrega.other_farm_works)) + sum(nz(nrega.plantations)) + sum(nz(nrega.soil_and_water_conservation))

variables.label: NREGA soil and water conservation works per 1000 ha, 2017–24
NREGA irrigation and soil-water conservation works per 1000 ha, 2017–24
variables.description: Public investment in water works: farm irrigation plus soil and water conservation (check dams, farm ponds, bunds).

variables.label: Share of MWS covered by villages in the Mission Antyodaya survey
Households with a piped water connection
Households living only on minor forest produce
Villages reporting a farmer producer organisation (FPO)
variables.description: Share of the MWS's villages (weighted by overlap area) whose Mission Antyodaya record lists an FPO, alone or with a PACS. A blank answer in a surveyed village is read as neither.

variables.label: Share of MWS covered by villages with facility distances
Distance to the nearest bank branch
variables.description: Straight-line distance from the village centre, averaged over the MWS's villages by area.

variables.label: Distance to the nearest cooperative society
variables.description: Exported for review only: 76% of sample villages are more than 50 km from a listed cooperative, which looks like incomplete coverage (see the API issues log), so no signal uses it.

variables.label: Distance to the farthest of bank branch, ATM, bank mitra and common service centre
A mapped river flows through the MWS
variables.expr: (1.0 if river.n > 0 else 0.0) if known(river.n) else nan

variables.label: Forest fringe deforested or degraded
variables.description: Share of the 50 m edge zone around stable forest that lost or thinned tree cover.

variables.label: Fire detections per 100 km² per year
Shrub NDVI trend decreasing
variables.expr: (1.0 if ndvi.shrub_trend == 'Decreasing' else 0.0) if is_text(ndvi.shrub_trend) else nan
variables.description: 1 when the ndvi dataset classes the shrubland NDVI trend as 'Decreasing'. Used instead of shrub_slope, which the API rounds to two decimals so that 96% of values are 0 (CS-87).
